basic_details.job_title: BEL Trainee Engineer I Recruitment 2026 Notification Out – Apply Online for 23 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL), Kotdwar Unit, a Navratna company under the Ministry of Defence, will fill 23 Trainee Engineer-I posts in Electronics (16), Mechanical (5) and Computer Science (2) on a temporary basis, at Rs. 40,000 per month in the first year. Online pre-registration at jobapply.in opens on 12 November 2026 and closes on 26 November 2026 at 11:59 PM. The written test is on 13 December 2026 at BEL Kotdwar.

how_to_apply: The process has two parts: online pre-registration for the Walk-In Selection, then the written test at Kotdwar.

Open the pre-registration link https://jobapply.in/bel2026kotdwarte, provided against the advertisement Recruitment of Trainee Engineer-I for Kotdwar Unit. It is available from 12.11.2026 to 26.11.2026.
Fill the necessary fields in the online application form, pay the requisite fee (if applicable) and submit the form.
Pay the fee through SBI Collect and enter the SBI Collect Reference Number generated after payment in the online application form.
Upload the documents listed under Documents to Upload below.

Submit only one application for a post. If a candidate applies more than once for one post, only the latest valid (completed) application is retained and the fee and other charges paid for the other applications are forfeited.
Verify every entry before submission. Changes are not permitted after submission.
Click the payment link on the BEL website, or go to www.onlinesbi.sbi and select State Bank Collect.
Accept the terms and conditions and click Proceed.
Select state of Corporation/Institution: All India.
Select PSU (Public Sector Undertaking): Bharat Electronics Limited, and press Submit.
Select payment category: Recruitment of Trainee Engineer-I for BEL-KOT, and complete the payment.
Save and print, or take a screenshot of, the payment receipt and attach it with the application form.
Recent colour passport size photograph and signature specimen.
10th/SSLC Standard Marks card as proof of date of birth.
12th/Diploma in Engineering Standard Marks Card.
Marks Card (all semesters/years) of the relevant qualification (BE/B.Tech/B.Sc. Engineering).
Self-attested copy of the final or provisional degree certificate of the relevant qualification.
Proof of norms for SGPA/CGPA/DGPA/OGPA or letter grade, or a document for percentage/class, issued by the university, institution or college.
Caste/Tribe/Community/Disability/EWS certificate in the prescribed format, for candidates claiming reservation as SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/PwBD/EWS.
PwBD candidates must have disability of not less than 40% and submit a disability certificate issued by a competent authority.

content_sections.heading: About the Recruiting Company
content_sections.text: Bharat Electronics Limited describes itself as a Navratna company and India's premier professional electronics company under the Ministry of Defence. Its Kotdwar Unit needs Trainee Engineer-I personnel on a temporary basis for its various project locations all over India. The written test and document verification are held at BEL Kotdwar, Pauri Garhwal, Uttarakhand.

content_sections.heading: Seats by Trade
content_sections.text: The notice lists 23 posts in three disciplines. The posting location for all posts is Kotdwar Unit and other locations all over India as per requirement. The notice states that the posts may vary based on actual requirement at the time of selection. For PwBD (Person with Benchmark Disability) candidates, reservation will be as per Government guidelines.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: All three posts require a full time B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc. Engineering (4-year course) degree with Pass Class from a recognized university or institution. The relevant disciplines for each post are below. No experience is required for any post. The degree must be from an AICTE/UGC approved college or institute, or a recognized university. Candidates must hold all year/semester marks sheets and the degree certificate. For CGPA grading, a conversion certificate must be attached and indicated in the online application form. If the qualifying degree does not mention the specialization, a certificate from the university, institution or college stating the specialization must be submitted at document verification. Candidates whose degree specialization does not tally with the branch mentioned in the application will not be considered for selection. Candidates indicating qualification in other disciplines will not be considered. The upper age limit is not more than 28 years for General and EWS candidates, as on 01.11.2026. Candidates can use the SSLC/SSC/ISC marks card or any other valid document as proof of date of birth. Candidates seeking age relaxation must attach a copy of the relevant certificate with the application and submit the original in case of selection or at any later stage for verification. EWS, OBC (NCL), SC, ST and disability certificates must be strictly in the format available on the BEL website; otherwise the candidate is considered under the General category, provided all other criteria for General candidates are met. OBC (NCL) certificates must be issued on or after 01.11.2025. EWS certificates must be issued on or after 01.04.2026 for the year 2026-27. The notice does not specify any qualification beyond the above. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

Full time B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc. Engineering (4-year course) with Pass Class in Computer Science, Computer Science Engineering, Computer Science & Engineering or Information Technology

rows.relaxation: 10 years, in addition to the relaxation applicable to the categories above

content_sections.heading: Stipend and Training Period
content_sections.text: Trainee Engineer-I will be engaged for an initial period of 2 years. This may be extended up to a maximum of one year (maximum tenure 3 years) based on project requirement and individual performance. A consolidated amount of Rs. 12,000 per year is paid for expenses such as insurance premium, attire allowance, stitching charges and footwear allowances. It is paid in two instalments: the first is processed in the first month's salary after joining, and the second after 6 months from the date of joining. Candidates posted to far flung and tough locations as and when project requirement arises will be paid 10% of the consolidated remuneration as Tough Location Allowance. Gratuity is admissible as per the applicable provisions of the Gratuity rules. Selected candidates are to be covered under a medical insurance scheme for Rs. 2 lakhs and a life insurance scheme for Rs. 5 lakhs per annum, which is to be submitted at the time of joining. The cost of housing accommodation will not be borne by the company. A Trainee Engineer who completes 2 years within BEL may be considered for advancement to Project Engineer-I in the same Unit, subject to these criteria: Performance assessment scores as Trainee Engineer of 80% and above marks for both years (aggregate). Attendance of more than 80% during the preceding 1 year, and good general discipline. No adverse remarks in the preceding 02 years. After advancement, engagement as Project Engineer-I is for 3 years, which may be extended up to a maximum of one year based on project requirement and performance, with approval of the competent authority. A Project Engineer who advanced from the Trainee Engineer role and completes an overall tenure of 4 years is entitled to a Retention Bonus of Rs. 25,000 for every completed year, payable at the end of 04 years, i.e. Rs. 1,00,000.

Candidates whose online applications are accepted and who meet the qualifying criteria will be provisionally shortlisted for the written test. The written test is held only at BEL Kotdwar on 13.12.2026 (Sunday). Each correct answer carries 1 mark and each wrong response carries a negative mark of 0.25. Minimum qualifying marks: 35% for General/EWS/OBC-NCL and 30% for SC/ST/PwBD. PwBD candidates are eligible for compensatory time of 20 minutes per hour. A scribe is permitted for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities as defined under Section 2(r) of the PwBD Act 2016, on production of the required medical certificate in the BEL format. Candidates arrange scribes at their own expense, and the scribe's qualification must be one step below the candidate's. There is no provision for re-checking or re-evaluation of answer sheets. Written test results will be uploaded on the BEL website. Candidates qualifying in the written test will be called for document verification based on merit. Lists of candidates shortlisted for the written test and final selections will be available on the BEL website www.bel-india.in (Careers Section). Reporting time: 8:00 AM. Venue: Bharat Electronics Limited, Kotdwar-246149, Pauri Garhwal (Uttarakhand). Bring a printed copy of the online application form. No separate call letter will be sent or issued. Bring a government-issued photo ID such as Driving Licence, Aadhaar, Voter ID, PAN Card or Passport. Without identity proof, a candidate will not be allowed to appear. No travelling expenses or allowance will be given for attending the Walk-in selection.

faq.question: Q1. How many Trainee Engineer-I vacancies are there in BEL Kotdwar?
faq.answer: BEL Kotdwar has 23 Trainee Engineer-I posts: 16 in Electronics, 5 in Mechanical and 2 in Computer Science.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for BEL Kotdwar pre-registration?
faq.answer: The last date is 26 November 2026 at 11:59 PM. The online link is available from 12 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for BEL Trainee Engineer-I?
faq.answer: Candidates need a full time B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc. Engineering (4-year course) degree with Pass Class in Electronics, Mechanical or Computer Science disciplines as listed. No experience is required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for BEL Trainee Engineer-I?
faq.answer: The age limit is not more than 28 years for General and EWS candidates as on 01.11.2026. SC and ST get 5 years' relaxation, OBC (NCL) 3 years, and PwBD with at least 40% disability get 10 years in addition.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of BEL Trainee Engineer-I?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration is Rs. 40,000 per month in the 1st year and Rs. 45,000 in the 2nd year. It is Rs. 50,000 in the 3rd year if the contract is extended.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for BEL Kotdwar recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, UR, EWS and OBC (NCL) candidates pay Rs.177/- (Rs.150/- + 18% GST). SC, ST and PwBD candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the BEL Kotdwar Trainee Engineer-I posts?
faq.answer: Pre-register online at https://jobapply.in/bel2026kotdwarte between 12 and 26 November 2026. Pay the fee through SBI Collect, enter the SBI Collect Reference Number and upload the documents.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for BEL Trainee Engineer-I?
faq.answer: Selection is through a written test of 100 questions in 90 minutes, followed by document verification of qualifying candidates based on merit. Each wrong answer carries a negative mark of 0.25.

faq.question: Q9. When and where is the BEL Kotdwar written test?
faq.answer: The written test is on 13 December 2026 (Sunday) at Bharat Electronics Limited, Kotdwar-246149, Pauri Garhwal (Uttarakhand). Reporting time is 8:00 AM.

faq.question: Q10. Is the BEL Trainee Engineer-I job permanent?
faq.answer: No, BEL requires the personnel on a temporary basis. The initial engagement is 2 years, which may be extended up to one year, for a maximum tenure of 3 years.
